from pathlib import Path
import json,urllib.request,concurrent.futures,hashlib
lock=json.load(open('/tmp/earshot-pyodide-lock.json')); names=['pyodide.js','pyodide.asm.js','pyodide.asm.wasm','python_stdlib.zip','pyodide-lock.json']+[lock['packages'][k]['file_name'] for k in ['numpy','scipy','libopenblas']]
def get(name):
 p=Path('/tmp/earshot-pyodide-download')/name
 if not p.exists():urllib.request.urlretrieve('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.28.3/full/'+name,p)
 return {'file':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'size':p.stat().st_size}
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as ex:rows=list(ex.map(get,names))
Path('classic/vendor/earshot/pyodide-assets.json').write_text(json.dumps({'version':'0.28.3','baseURL':'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.28.3/full/','assets':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
print(rows)
